annotation.title_clean: AI Factories | Shaping Europe's digital future
annotation.title_en: AI Factories | Shaping Europe's digital future
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, DG Communications Networks, Content and Technology (DG CONNECT)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page describing EU AI Factories and planned AI Gigafactories: EuroHPC-based supercomputing hubs supporting startups, SMEs and researchers in developing trustworthy generative AI. It lists the selected factories and antennas and funding of about €10 billion. It is innovation-policy information with no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: 19 AI Factories and 13 Antennas are being set up through the EuroHPC JU, with at least 9 new AI-optimised supercomputers.
Call for tenders for up to seven AI Gigafactories with over 100,000 advanced AI processors.
Up to €10 billion EU and national funding, expected to unlock at least €20 billion private investment.
Priority access for AI startups and SMEs; networked with Testing and Experimentation Facilities and Digital Innovation Hubs.
Positioned as supporting trustworthy AI aligned with the AI Act.
